name: Transactional Command Idempotency
description: Commands capable of creating duplicate financial, order, inventory, refund, fulfillment or return effects require a canonical idempotency key when the command registry marks them idempotent.
purpose: Commands capable of creating duplicate financial, order, inventory, refund, fulfillment or return effects require a canonical idempotency key when the command registry marks them idempotent.

requirements.description: Commands capable of creating duplicate financial, order, inventory, refund, fulfillment or return effects require a canonical idempotency key when the command registry marks them idempotent.
The rule must be evaluated from authoritative server-side state and must not trust browser-calculated or provider-reported state without required validation/reconciliation.

failure.notes: Phase 12 defines the domain error identifier. HTTP mapping and response envelopes are reserved for Phase 18.

relationships.description: This rule constrains commerce.order operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.payment operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.refund operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.inventoryReservation operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.fulfillment operations or state.

valid: An operation involving commerce.order, commerce.payment satisfies the rule before authoritative state is committed.
invalid: An implementation bypasses commerce.rule.transactionalCommandIdempotency and commits a conflicting or unverifiable state.

implementationNotes: Enforce at the server-side commerce domain boundary.
Use canonical Phase 11 schemas as the data model; do not create shadow transaction models.
If provider behavior differs, translate through an adapter and reconcile to canonical NEXT F state.
